trigger: The high-size extension showed max emitted batches near one GiB and a task transition from one to multiple batches near observed median turnover.
design: full 3x3x3 factorial per query, three seeded randomized complete blocks after one warmup/query
primary_tests: Does max emitted batch track the general RAPIDS target while MPB is held fixed?
Does reader soft limit independently alter batch count/size or query time?
Does the preferred MPB change with either batch control?
interpretation: Factor interactions and within-cell medians are exploratory with n=3. Evidence of target response supports mediation; it does not isolate all scheduling and I/O paths.
